source.title: Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1905, p. 5 ("Nominations: County Councillors")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names read from the page images; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1905: polled 25 May 1905 in five divisions (counted 26 May by T. W. Kilpatrick, returning officer). Markethill is not filed: both Armagh Guardian nomination lists print "Markethill—Wm. Simpson, J.P.", the Hamiltonsbawn member, apparently in error. Returned unopposed. Jacob Orr: no party label printed in 1905. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Annaghmore, Armagh Rural District, 28 May 1902, printed 'Unionist': Armagh Guardian, 2 May 1902, p. 2 ("District Councils": nominations with labels, withdrawals, and "Newry"); Annaghmore, Armagh Rural District, 25 May 1905, printed 'Unionist': Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1905, p. 5 ("Guardians' Nominations"; "All the candidates are Unionists save where marked N."); withdrawals from the Armagh Guardian, 5 May 1905, p. 4 ("Poor Law Guardians": contests and withdrawals)).
